scoring_justification: The scaling-law modulus is recomputed from submitted core/surface parameters to verify self-consistency (T1). All other quantities are compared against paper-reported gold values with monotonic tolerances (T0).

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold bulk SOEC values from MD simulation
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table 1, MD-EAM Au SOEC values
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are the exact reported MD results

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold bulk TOEC values from MD simulation (including c456 not shown in paper)
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table 1 for c111..c123; c456 obtained from the MD simulation
hidden_assets.generation_method: Taken from paper Table 1 and the reference MD simulation result
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are the correct MD-EAM results; the reference simulation yields -200.0 GPa for c456

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold surface eigenstress and surface Young's moduli for (110) surface
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are the reported MD surface parameters

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold core pseudo-uniaxial Young's moduli Y_x^c and Ỹ_x^c derived from bulk constants
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table 2 and the derived formulas; reference MD simulation
hidden_assets.generation_method: Computed from the rotated bulk constants; the reference solve.sh uses 140.80 and -827.7 GPa
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are consistent with the paper's core moduli definitions and the MD simulation

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold nominal Young's modulus from direct tension test at 3 nm
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Figure 5 / directly simulated value for h=3 nm
hidden_assets.generation_method: From the MD direct tension test; the reference solve.sh uses 154.0 GPa
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Value is the correct MD result for the pseudo-uniaxial tension test at 3 nm

outputs.description: The scored artifact containing MD-derived bulk and surface elastic constants, and the nominal Young's moduli from the scaling law and direct tension test.

output_contract.notes: The checker recomputes the scaling-law modulus from the submitted core and surface parameters and verifies self-consistency; it compares all submitted values against hidden paper-reported references.
